Nilbog grew up much like any other normal goblin, which is to say in a cage.

Goblins will often toss their young into a pen and occasionally feed them by

throwing scraps inside. Nilbog was not like the other goblins though, when he saw

his brothers and sisters eating each other or playing tricks like 'shank the

loser' he couldn't help but think it was all just a bit... excessive. He learned

to survive by hiding from the more violent members of his litter and squeezing

himself into unlikely spots wherein he was hard to reach.

As Nilbog got older and was allowed out of the youngsters pen he was accepted

grudgingly as a scout by the rest of the tribe. Being a clever young fellow he

accepted a suitable amount of bullying by the beefier goblins destined for

leadership. He was always regarded with suspicion though for his apparent

hesitancy in normal social events like a casual burning or orgy.

One day Nilbog was assigned to a raid on a nearby human road. The goblins saw a

man on a cart. The mans clothes were very odd, blue and gold with a symbol around

his neck. A woman and her litter rode on the back. Nilbog broke out in a cold

sweat as the enormity of what was about to happen dawned on him. He broke cover

to wave off the cart but it was too late, he watched as his tribe mates unleashed

a hail of stones and proceeded to variously murder, eat, and rape the humans in a

mixture of orders.

That night, overcome with horror at what had occurred, Nilbog stood watch and

made his decision. Using the one talent he possessed he stealthily slit the

throats of his litter mates in their sleep. He took up the humans valubles, a few

weapons, some armor, and a bit of coin. With that he wandered into human lands

with a single thought on his mind... Can't we all just get along?
